description: Add search functionality to dropdown menus in single-select and multi-select survey questions. This will allow users to quickly find and select options from long lists by typing in a search field within the dropdown interface. The feature should be implemented across both single and multiple choice question types.
functional_requirements: Add a search input field at the top of dropdown menus for single-select and multi-select questions
Filter dropdown options in real-time as users type in the search field
Maintain all existing dropdown functionality (selection, display, accessibility) while adding search capability
Implement the searchable dropdown component in a reusable way that works with both question types
Ensure the search functionality works correctly with internationalized text across all supported languages
Include clear visual indicators that the dropdown is searchable (e.g., search icon, placeholder text)
